# Place lookup fixture

`white-house-overpass.json` contains the White House building relation returned by
the VK Maps public Overpass instance on 2026-11-14. Coordinates and topology are
unmodified. It is a small test extraction of OpenStreetMap data, not a recorded
user location or a guaranteed future boundary.

© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0:
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
Source object: https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/19761182
Service: https://maps.mail.ru/osm/tools/overpass/api/interpreter

The corresponding browser-exported SDK snapshot is tested in
`Tests/SheepFenceTests/Fixtures/quick-add-white-house.geojson` and retains source
attribution and the license reference in feature properties.
